title: Reactivation message wording, from one part and from bulk
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
custom_steps:
1. Read the reactivation confirmation from one part's edit dialog.
  2. Read it from a selection of several parts (and of one).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • From one part's edit dialog the reactivation states "This part can be added to new work again." and nothing further; from a selection it states "These parts can be added to new work again." (or "This part..." for one) followed by "Existing records that use them stay as they are."

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 10 (Confirming & recording a status change); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R23: “For a reactivation raised from one part's edit dialog, the confirmation states "This part can be added to new work again." and nothing further. Raised from a selection it states "These parts can be added to new work again." (or "This part ..." for one) followed by "Existing records that use them stay as they are." Reactivating puts a part back in part lookup and has no other effect, so there is nothing else to rule out.”
